cards.title: Study output has room; the carried excerpt loses Minime’s answer
cards.body: Nine user-selected Minime journals completed September 9 12:08–12:26 PDT. All nine exact requests use gemma4:12b, num_predict 4096, context 10240 and think false; all stop normally with 144–1037 output tokens (median 371), full visible bodies preserved. Eight source inputs cover four exact intervals twice. Minime correctly articulates persistent worker versus per-chain task, but the next request truncates his answer in a 700-byte head excerpt while retaining the same older question. A separate reflection chooses MAP; no parser-reset finding. Installed model metadata advertises thinking capability. Propose shared retention/synthesis improvements and a bounded thinking trial; a queue-rejection caller-completion test is a separate code-review lead. No live changes, induced generation, daily-cursor change or causal improvement claim.
cards.source: Mike’s nine selected September 9 journals; Codex investigation
